blurb: Experience the true wilderness of Algonquin Provincial Park on one of our guided multi-day canoe adventures. Paddle pristine lakes, explore historic canoe routes, camp at secluded backcountry sites, and disconnect from the everyday while surrounded by breathtaking scenery. Whether you're new to canoe camping or an experienced adventurer, our knowledgeable guides provide the skills, equipment, meals, and support
